subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC#3 NOT MET — live_preview is dead code. setCommonConfig destructures live_preview and calls (query as any).addParam({ preview_hash: previewHash }), but NONE of the public functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries) destructure or forward live_preview to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery. They all use explicit destructuring without a rest operator, so live_preview is silently dropped at every call site. The setCommonConfig live_preview handling is unreachable — preview context can never flow through to Contentstack queries. This directly contradicts AC#3 and the prior review feedback item: 'query config interfaces lack live_preview fields to forward preview context through to Contentstack queries'.
issues.suggestedFix: Add live_preview to the destructuring of each public function and forward it to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery. For example, in getEntry: change the signature destructuring to include live_preview and pass it in the createContentTypeQuery call. Alternatively, use a rest operator (...commonConfig) in each public function's destructuring so that live_preview (and any future ICommonContentstackConfig fields) are automatically forwarded.

issues.description: No test verifies that live_preview context actually flows through a public function (getEntry, getSingleEntry, etc.) to the query's addParam method. The 4 new tests only check the options object and setHost behavior. Since the forwarding code in setCommonConfig is dead code (see blocker above), no test can catch this regression. AC#4 requires tests covering preview context forwarding, and the prior review feedback explicitly called out missing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test that calls getEntry (or getSingleEntry) with a live_preview parameter (e.g., { live_preview: { preview_hash: 'test_hash_123' } }) and asserts that the mock's addParam was called with { preview_hash: 'test_hash_123' }. This proves AC#3 is met end-to-end.

issues.description: The public function signatures (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries) do not include live_preview in their parameter destructuring even though their input types (IContentstackGetEntry, IContentstackGetSingleEntry, IContentstackGetSingletonEntry) extend ICommonContentstackConfig which now includes live_preview. A caller can pass live_preview (the type allows it) but it will never reach setCommonConfig. This is a type-safety gap — the compiler allows it but the runtime silently drops it.
issues.suggestedFix: Use rest operators in the public function destructuring (e.g., ...commonConfig) and spread into createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery calls, ensuring all ICommonContentstackConfig fields including live_preview are forwarded automatically.
